op_hi: The Decline of Traditional Reading Habits
q_hi:
Comprehension:
Read the passage and answer the following questions that follow.

Over the last decade, community libraries in small towns have transformed into vibrant learning hubs. Earlier, these libraries functioned mainly as quiet reading rooms where children prepared for exams and adults browsed newspapers. However, with increasing digital access and community participation, their role has expanded significantly. Many libraries now host storytelling sessions, digital literacy workshops, and discussion circles on art, science, and social issues. These changes have encouraged greater intergenerational interaction, as grandparents accompany children for reading hours while young volunteers teach older adults to use smartphones. Despite limited funding, library staff creatively utilize available spaces to set up reading corners, activity rooms, and mobile library vans. The evolution of these libraries demonstrates how public spaces can adapt to changing societal needs. Most importantly, they have become places that nurture curiosity, bridge age gaps, and foster a sense of collective belonging within the community.

Identify the most suitable title for the passage.
